title: 5 Stars to Alessandro and this amazing tour!
text:
Definitely ask for Alessandro for this tour! He is very well educated in the culture and history surrounding Barcelona, and Spain as a whole! He was very accommodating to both my girlfriend and I, and went with the pace that we wanted to go on for the tour. Didn't feel rushed or pressured to move onto the next spot. Price was very reasonable for the amount of food and alcohol we consumed.

Our experience with his personal 1-on-1 tour was so memorable, that he would be one of the top reasons why we would come back to Spain just to visit him and catch up in Barcelona
author: alexanderpT6949RK

title: Fantastic
text: We did the tapas tour in Barcelona, great experience! Ester, the guide, was very nice and took us to little restaurants where only local people go. I recommend it to everybody!
